layout.title: 2D floorplan storage
layout.description:
Where the layout of your floorplan should be kept.

For example `{example}` is stored as `{example}/2d-floorplan.json`.

dashboard.title: Dashboard beschrijven
dashboard.description:
Het pad is het adres van je dashboard, dus wat er achter `lovelace/` staat. `2d-floorplan` betekent `/lovelace/2d-floorplan`.

De entities worden uit het dashboard gelezen en in het script gezet. Wat er daarna in staat, is van jou.

abort.already_configured: This entry is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: Another dialog for this dashboard is still open. Close it and try again.
